question_text: The total cost C(x) in rupees of producing x units of an item is C(x) = 0.005x³ − 0.02x² + 30x + 500. Find the marginal cost when 3 units are produced. (Marginal cost is the rate of change of total cost.)

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Differentiate the cost function
steps.margin_note: First mark. This is a rate measure question. Differentiate term by term and keep the decimals exact: 0.005 × 3 = 0.015 and 0.02 × 2 = 0.04. The constant 500 differentiates to 0.
steps.memory_tip: Marginal means derivative. Marginal cost is dC/dx and marginal revenue is dR/dx — the word marginal is the instruction to differentiate.
lines: This is a rate measure question. Marginal cost is the rate of change of total cost,

recall.must_convey: That marginal cost is dC/dx, and that differentiating C(x) gives 0.015x² − 0.04x + 30.
accept: marginal cost is the derivative of the cost function
differentiate C of x to get zero point zero one five x squared minus zero point zero four x plus thirty

marginal cost ante derivative, so differentiate cheyyali

steps.why: The question defines marginal cost for you as a rate of change, so the whole method is one differentiation. Writing dC/dx and differentiating earns the method mark even before any number is substituted.
common_mistakes: Substituting x = 3 into C(x) itself, which gives the total cost 589.955 and not the rate.
Dropping a decimal place, writing 0.015x² as 0.15x².

steps.label: Substitute x = 3
steps.margin_note: Second mark. 0.135 − 0.12 = 0.015, so the answer is 30.015 and not 30. Write the unit: rupees per unit.
steps.memory_tip: Check the size before writing: the 30x term alone contributes 30 and the two small terms almost cancel, so the answer must sit just above 30.

lines.text: ∴ marginal cost when 3 units are produced = 30.015 rupees per unit

recall.must_convey: That substituting x = 3 gives 30.015 rupees per unit.

steps.why: The answer is a rate, so it carries the unit rupees per unit of output. The two small terms nearly cancel, which is why the value sits just above 30.
common_mistakes: Rounding to 30.02. The value 30.015 is exact and terminating, so there is nothing to round.
Leaving the answer with no unit.

insider_note: Marginal cost means dC/dx, not C(x)/x — the average cost is a different quantity. Differentiate first, then substitute x = 3.
